data.title: Donald Trump administration held Iran deportation talks during Operation Epic Fury | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: One of the detainees attempted suicide once he learned he could be deported to Iran, according to the Iranian American Legal Defense Fund’s executive director Yasmine Chubin.
